Apple___Apple_scab.cause: Caused by the fungus Venturia inaequalis.
Apple___Apple_scab.treatment: Apply recommended fungicides and remove infected leaves and fallen debris.
Apple___Apple_scab.prevention: Prune trees for good airflow and practice orchard sanitation.

Apple___Black_rot.cause: Caused by the fungus Botryosphaeria obtusa.
Apple___Black_rot.treatment: Remove infected fruits and branches and apply fungicides.
Apple___Black_rot.prevention: Prune diseased wood and keep the orchard clean.

Apple___Cedar_apple_rust.cause: Caused by Gymnosporangium fungi that alternate between apple and cedar hosts.
Apple___Cedar_apple_rust.treatment: Apply preventive fungicides and remove infected tissues.
Apple___Cedar_apple_rust.prevention: Avoid nearby cedar hosts where practical and maintain orchard hygiene.

Cherry_(including_sour)___Powdery_mildew.cause: Caused by powdery mildew fungi under humid conditions.
Cherry_(including_sour)___Powdery_mildew.treatment: Apply sulfur or other suitable fungicides and remove infected leaves.
Cherry_(including_sour)___Powdery_mildew.prevention: Improve air circulation and avoid excessive humidity.

Corn_(maize)___Cercospora_leaf_spot Gray.prevention: Crop rotation and resistant hybrids help reduce infection.

Corn_(maize)___Common_rust_.treatment: Use fungicides when disease pressure is high.
Corn_(maize)___Common_rust_.prevention: Grow resistant varieties and rotate crops.

Corn_(maize)___Northern_Leaf_Blight.prevention: Use resistant hybrids and crop rotation.

Grape___Black_rot.treatment: Remove infected tissues and apply fungicides.
Grape___Black_rot.prevention: Prune vines and improve air circulation.

Grape___Esca_(Black_Measles).treatment: Prune infected wood and remove severely affected vines.
Grape___Esca_(Black_Measles).prevention: Avoid pruning wounds during wet conditions and sanitize tools.

Grape___Leaf_blight_(Isariopsis_Leaf_Spo.treatment: Apply suitable fungicides and remove infected leaves.

Orange___Haunglongbing_(Citrus_greening).cause: Bacterial disease spread by Asian citrus psyllids.
Orange___Haunglongbing_(Citrus_greening).treatment: No complete cure; manage vectors and remove severely infected trees.
Orange___Haunglongbing_(Citrus_greening).prevention: Use disease-free planting material and control psyllids.

Peach___Bacterial_spot.prevention: Plant resistant cultivars and avoid overhead irrigation.

Pepper,_bell___Bacterial_spot.treatment: Apply copper-based bactericides and remove infected plants.
Pepper,_bell___Bacterial_spot.prevention: Use certified seeds and avoid working with wet plants.

Potato___Early_blight.treatment: Apply fungicides and remove infected foliage.
Potato___Early_blight.prevention: Rotate crops and avoid prolonged leaf wetness.

Potato___Late_blight.treatment: Use recommended fungicides and remove infected plants.
Potato___Late_blight.prevention: Use certified seed potatoes and ensure good field drainage.

Strawberry___Leaf_scorch.treatment: Remove infected leaves and apply fungicides if necessary.
Strawberry___Leaf_scorch.prevention: Avoid overhead irrigation and maintain field sanitation.

Tomato___Bacterial_spot.treatment: Apply copper-based bactericides and remove infected leaves.
Tomato___Bacterial_spot.prevention: Use certified seeds and avoid overhead watering.

Tomato___Early_blight.treatment: Apply fungicides and prune infected foliage.
Tomato___Early_blight.prevention: Rotate crops and improve air circulation.

Tomato___Late_blight.treatment: Apply appropriate fungicides and remove infected plants.
Tomato___Late_blight.prevention: Reduce humidity and avoid overhead irrigation.

Tomato___Septoria_leaf_spot.treatment: Remove infected leaves and apply fungicides.
Tomato___Septoria_leaf_spot.prevention: Rotate crops and avoid wet foliage.

Tomato___Spider_mites Two-spotted_spider.prevention: Maintain adequate humidity and monitor plants regularly.

Tomato___Target_Spot.prevention: Improve air circulation and remove infected debris.

Tomato___Tomato_Yellow_Leaf_Curl_Virus.treatment: No cure; remove infected plants and control whiteflies.
Tomato___Tomato_Yellow_Leaf_Curl_Virus.prevention: Use resistant varieties and manage insect vectors.

Tomato___Tomato_mosaic_virus.prevention: Disinfect tools and use disease-free seeds.
